@graph.howPerformed: The HydraFacial process follows four steps. Cleanse + Peel removes dead skin cells and debris. An optional Extend step adds lymphatic drainage to boost circulation for a vibrant, healthy complexion.

mainEntity.name: How long does a HydraFacial session take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical session lasts about 30 to 60 minutes, making it a quick and efficient skincare treatment.

mainEntity.name: Is HydraFacial suitable for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. HydraFacial is gentle and can be customized for most skin types, including sensitive skin.

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a HydraFacial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly sessions are recommended for best results. Your dermatologist may adjust the frequency based on your skin's needs.

mainEntity.name: Is there any downtime or side effects?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no downtime. Slight redness may occur and usually subsides within a few hours. Use sunscreen, and avoid heavy makeup for 24 hours.
